an4.129:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.
an4.129:1.3: sace bhikkhave bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:1.4: tattha ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:1.5: atittāva bhikkhave bhikkhuparisā hoti. atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
an4.129:2.1: sace bhikkhave bhikkhunīparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:2.2: tattha ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:2.3: atittāva bhikkhave bhikkhunīparisā hoti. atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
an4.129:3.1: sace bhikkhave upāsakaparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:3.2: tattha ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:3.3: atittāva bhikkhave upāsakaparisā hoti. atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
an4.129:4.1: sace bhikkhave upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:4.2: tattha ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti.
an4.129:4.3: atittāva bhikkhave upāsikāparisā hoti. atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
an4.129:4.4: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānandeti.
